segments.author: Jason
segments.text: Once upon a time there was a boy who built a rocket ship out of a cardboard box and a whole roll of tape, and the rocket was named Rocket.

segments.author: Trenton
segments.text: And then Rocket flew far far away to grandpa's house and they had waffles for dinner. The end. Wait — no. Rocket also flew up and up to the moon and the moon had a big slide.

characters.name: The Boy
characters.canonical: A single small boy with a big round head about one-third of his height and short sturdy legs, drawn in loose lively ink outline with full saturated watercolor fill: warm tan skin, tousled dark brown hair, two round black eyes with dot pupils, a small round button nose, a wide open smile, rosy cheeks, wearing a bright red long-sleeve shirt, sunny yellow overalls and orange sneakers, with a roll of silver-grey tape looped on one wrist.

features: two round black eyes with dot pupils
attributes.size: small child, head about one-third of his height
attributes.clothing: bright red long-sleeve shirt, sunny yellow overalls, orange sneakers
attributes.expression: wide open smile, eyes bright and happy

characters.name: Rocket
characters.species: rocket ship built from a cardboard box and a whole roll of tape
characters.canonical: A single rocket ship named Rocket, built out of one brown corrugated cardboard box with a taped-on cone nose and three cardboard fins, wrapped all over in shiny silver-grey tape strips and criss-crosses, drawn in loose lively ink outline with full saturated watercolor fill: warm kraft-brown cardboard body with visible flute edges, a bright red nose cone tip, a big round porthole window ringed in red, sunny yellow star crayon-drawn on its side, and orange-and-yellow flame puffing from its taped base.

colors: bright red nose cone and porthole ring
features: cardboard box body with corrugated flute edges
whole roll of tape wrapped in criss-crossing strips
attributes.size: boy-sized box rocket, about as tall as the boy
attributes.expression: none — it is a rocket, but it reads cheerful and jaunty

characters.name: Grandpa
characters.canonical: A single kindly grandpa, tall and round-bellied with a head about one-quarter of his height, drawn in loose lively ink outline with full saturated watercolor fill: warm tan skin, fluffy white hair and a short white beard, two round black eyes behind round gold-rimmed glasses, a soft round nose, a wide warm smile, wearing a bright red-and-orange checked shirt, cosy yellow cardigan, soft blue trousers and orange slippers.

features: fluffy white hair and short white beard
attributes.size: tall grown-up, head about one-quarter of his height
attributes.clothing: red-and-orange checked shirt, yellow cardigan, blue trousers, orange slippers
attributes.expression: wide warm smile, crinkled happy eyes

characters.name: The Waffles
characters.canonical: One stack of three thick golden-brown square waffles with deep criss-cross grid squares, drawn in loose lively ink outline with full saturated watercolor fill, sitting on a bright red round plate with a pat of sunny yellow butter melting on top and orange-amber syrup dripping down the sides.

attributes.size: a plate-sized stack, small in the boy's hands
attributes.expression: none — food object, drawn warm and inviting

characters.name: The Moon with the Big Slide
characters.canonical: A single round pale-cream moon, a big smooth ball dotted with soft grey craters, drawn in loose lively ink outline with full saturated watercolor fill, with one big bright red curving slide attached to its side that spirals down from the top and ends in an orange lip, plus a sunny yellow ladder climbing its curve; the moon has a friendly face of two round black eyes, a small round nose and a wide smiling mouth.

features: friendly face with two eyes, nose and smile
attributes.size: huge — big enough for the boy and Rocket to stand on
attributes.expression: wide smiling mouth, bright happy eyes
